A fair-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a level of [[Force-attunement]], '''Feyn Gospic'''<ref name="CCG" /> served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between them and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="anh" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he<ref name="CCG" /> became a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|355|Gospic, Feyn}}</ref> Stationed with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]],<ref name="anh" /> Gospic was one of Dodonna's chief strategic advisors prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CSWE" /> When Dodonna received the [[Death Star plans/Legends|secret plans]] for the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]],<ref name="anh" /> Gospic and others frantically searched for possibilities to destroy the [[Space station/Legends|station]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|67|MIL 5-8|Escape of the ''Millennium Falcon''}}</ref> with Gospic devising the plans for<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet's]] approach to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="CCG" />

In the battle itself, Gospic served as one of Dodonna's main strategic advisors.<ref name="Guardians">{{SW|url=news/yavin-4-rebels-guardians-of-the-hidden-fortress|text=Yavin 4 Rebels: Guardians of the Hidden Fortress|nolive=1}}</ref> Within the strategy center, Gospic used an [[OrC-19 com-scan integrator console]] to electronically monitor the Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] attacking the Death Star. The battle was ultimately won with the Alliance destroying the Death Star. Gospic wore a gray [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and a [[headset comlink]].<ref name="anh" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feyn Gospic first appeared in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first film of the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="anh" /> Gospic's scene was filmed between [[May 13]] and [[May 18]], [[1976]] at [[Shepperton Studios]]'s stage H.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> He was first named by [[Decipher]] in [[1998]], for their ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" />
